Right now, in your world,
a hyperdimensional lifeform called Holowculus is approaching.

Since it's a mouthful, just call me
Tawā.

preying on all existence…

m920014.こんなところにはいられない……！\nもう私帰る！: I can't stay here… I'm leaving!

m920014.さらに魔物の動きが素早くなっていますね……。\n王子、気を付けてください。油断は: The monsters are even faster now… Prince, stay on guard. Letting your guard down is fatal.
m920014.すごい熱気！\nここに召喚獣がいるのですか？: Such intense heat! Is the summoned beast here?
m920014.そういえばお礼を忘れてたわね。\nさっきは助けてくれてありがとう。: Speaking of which, I forgot to thank you. Thanks for helping me earlier.
m920014.そうよ。\nさあ、私の声に答えなさい。: It is. Now answer my call.
m920014.そこでは癒し手の力が妨害されているようです。\nヒーラーたちが傷ついた仲間を癒す: It seems the healers' powers are being suppressed here. They can't heal wounded allies.
m920014.それよりも早くここから\n連れ出して！: More importantly, get me out of here right now!
m920014.って……あれ？ \n私、どこから来たんだっけ？: Wait… where did I come from again?

m920014.ついた！ ここよ！: We've arrived! This is the spot!
m920014.でもそれを、こうも倒しちゃうなんて。\nあなたたち一体何者なのよ。: And we managed to take them down like this. Who on earth are you?

m920014.どのような罠が待ち構えているのか……\n気をつけるのですよ。: What kind of trap lies ahead…? Stay on your guard.

m920014.ねえ、私の召喚獣探しを手伝ってよ。: Hey, help me find my summoned beast.

m920014.ふーん、小さい子なんていたかしら？\nって、もしかしてそれ私のことじゃ……。: Hmm, was there a little child? Wait, could that be referring to me…?
m920014.まさか召喚獣が大量発生するなんてね……。: I never imagined the summoned beasts would spawn in such numbers...
m920014.もう、なんでもっと早く来ないのよ！\n心細かったじゃないの！\nこの役立たず！: Ugh, why didn't you come sooner! I was so scared! You useless—
m920014.もう、何なのよここは！\n暗くてジメジメしてるし……。: Ugh, what is this place! It's dark and damp…
m920014.やったわ！ これで私も一人前よ！\nんじゃ、無事召喚獣も手に入ったし。\n約束通: Yes! That makes me a proper one! Now that we've safely secured the summoned beast, as promised, I'll lend you my power.
m920014.わ、もう来るわ！\nちょっと早く何とかしてよ！: They're already coming! Hurry up and do something!
m920014.コンナトコロニ、ニンゲン！\nミツケタ！: In this place, human! I found you!
m920014.一人前の召喚士になるためには、\n召喚獣を手に入れることが必須条件。: To become a full-fledged summoner, obtaining a summoned beast is essential.

m920014.魔物たちが接近してきます。\n報告によると、進軍の速度が\nいつもより速いようで: The monsters are closing in. Reports say they're moving faster than usual.

m920023.あの鬼は実体を持たない身、\n突然現れ、戦場をかき乱すでしょう。\nご……注意を: That demon has no physical form; it'll appear suddenly and throw the battlefield into chaos. Please… be careful…

m920023.そうですか……。\nあなたたちには申し訳ない事をいたしました。\n私の力が及ばぬ: I see… I'm sorry for what I've done to you all. My power wasn't enough…

m920023.もうやめてください！！\nこれ以上、この力を乱用すると……。: Please stop!! If you keep abusing this power…
m920023.ハァ……。 ハァ……。\n戦いは終わった……のですか？: Hah… Hah… Is the battle… over?

m920023.王子よ。ここで貴様を叩き斬っても良いが、\n次の楽しみにしておくとしよう。\nで: Prince. I could cut you down here, but I'll save that for next time. See you on the next battlefield.

m920023.王子！ 新手です！\n注意してください！: Prince! A new type! Be careful!
m920023.砲撃部隊よ、準備を進めろ！\n砲撃で人間共をズタズタに\nしてやるのだ！: Artillery units, prepare! We'll tear these humans to shreds with our cannon fire!
m920023.私の名はモミジ。\nあなたたちと争うつもりはありません。\n私の刀は……人を……: My name is Momiji. I have no intention of fighting you. My blade… protects people…
m920023.行ってしまったようですね……。\nあの様子、どうやら魔物に意識を\n乗っ取られて: Looks like they've gone… From the way they act, it seems the monster has taken over their mind.
m920023.追ってきたか。\n影の魔物で翻弄してやろう。\nさぁ、かかってくるがいい！: So you followed us. I'll toy with you using shadow monsters. Come on, give it your best!

m920023.魔物が出現したと報告があった場所は\nここですね。: The place where we got reports of monsters appearing is… here, right?

m920023.黙れ！！ もっとだ。\nもっと力を解放するのだ！！: Shut up!! More. Release even more power!!

but you took me all over the place… um…

and the Snowbranch village is complete.

You scum, bare your fangs and roar!!

Northern Great Nation Knight: ――Fluffy! Powawa!
Get to safety, quickly!!

The food changes depending on where you are, but
the northernmost lands… no, the Interstice Snowfield is full of fine cuisine too.

――Prince! We have intruders!
They're a group of unidentified beastfolk!
They're skilled fighters who've taken down our guards!

……Ugh.
